skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the concept of scientific research, its purpose, and significance.
Know how to choose a research topic and construct a research outline.
Understand APA citation style and how to format references.
Apply writing techniques to summarize, paraphrase, evaluate perspectives, and research results.
Understand research methods and select appropriate ones for specific research.
Analyze research data and write a complete scientific research report.
Develop group work skills and independent research abilities.
Develop critical thinking, analytical, synthesis, problem identification, and solving skills.
